annotations.title: Use a vault secret in a request

description: Send an HTTPS request with a vault secret substituted into the url or body. The caller chooses the URL and the method. The secret is never returned. Suggest when: a stored secret is needed; never print the value. Store or reveal it only on Profile → Vault. [C v5.66286e:H,R05s]
name: vault_inject
